name: storm_breaker_v22
cad_source: mechanical/assemblies/full_robot/v22 (STEP frame +y forward, +x right; robot frame here x forward, y left)

intake.source: v22 CAD: INT_ parts span y_left -190..208 mm and reach the front edge (x 249 mm); reach 0-60 mm ball centre height above the head lift (head roller at 95 mm, head down); body front without the head 115 mm (INT_centrador); capacity = 6 basket + 12 tower REF balls. Port DC1 is an assumption (TBD).

mechanisms.source: v22 CAD parts and motors. Ports are assumptions (TBD with the electrical team); speeds marked estimate.

elevator.note: carriage travel from the two v22 STEP files; DC37 50 rpm x 90T GT2 pulley (180 mm/rev) = 150 mm/s

intake_lift.note: INT_UR head on 428 mm rails (z 102-530 mm, 40 mm slides): ~380 mm travel; DC25 ~200 rpm x 16 mm lead (T8x16) = 53 mm/s, estimate

intake_rollers.note: INT_motor_DC37_200rpm (same port as the intake model)

shooter.note: brushless friction wheels, estimate; the 3D view caps the displayed speed
